title: TaSR-RAG: Taxonomy-guided Structured Reasoning for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Jiashuo Sun; Yixuan Xie; Jimeng Shi; Shaowen Wang; Jiawei Han
why_relevant: Proposes a structured reasoning RAG method for multi-hop QA, with incidental claims about reducing distraction via typed triples, but does not directly study robustness, conflict, or calibration.
